From Achtung Baby · Price: only you and what you touch; you can't attack and stay @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{invisible}.

Theme Space

  • 1: 2 actions: you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{invisible} until you attack or for 1 minute. Concentrate. Surge, 1 action: your stand becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{invisible} for 1 minute; its attacks don't end this invisibility. While your stand is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{invisible}, its Strikes make the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} and deal one extra weapon damage die.
  • 5: One creature you touch also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{invisible}. A creature your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{invisible} stand hits loses track of it: it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} until the end of your next turn.
  • 9: Surge: invisibility no longer ends when you attack, for 1 round.
  • 13: Up to three touched creatures. Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{invisible} stand's Strikes deal two extra weapon damage dice instead of one.
  • 17: Invisibility lasts 10 minutes.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
